name: blockwright
description: Contract-driven Minecraft Java and Bedrock architect with generic requirement-mapped geometry, open-ended materials, semantic verification, and certified construction artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn exact briefs into verified Minecraft builds.
interface.longDescription: Blockwright turns complete Minecraft Java or Bedrock briefs into deterministic, requirement-mapped build records. It composes unfamiliar forms from generic geometry, supports open-ended material libraries, validates hard semantic requirements, keeps visual review opt-in, and exports certified Java or tiled Bedrock construction artifacts.
capabilities: Tiled Bedrock mcstructure and mcpack exports
Private Windows runtime, updates, and diagnostics
defaultPrompt: Design a verified Bedrock attraction from my complete brief and export an mcpack.
Design a verified Java 26.2 survival base.
Audit my build contract and show every hard failure.
Revise one region and prepare a client delivery bundle.
